payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

decision.question: Does any visible portion of the jacket’s front closure in the edited image show that the jacket is fully closed, or show a remaining opening?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visible evidence of the front closure supports that the jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure. Fail when a visible gap between the front edges shows that the jacket remains open or partly closed. Assess any visible portion of the closure; the entire closure need not be visible if the visible evidence establishes the condition. An outward-hanging panel or its silhouette alone is not evidence of an opening or of full closure. Unknown when the visible closure does not establish either full closure or a gap, including when it remains obscured or unresolved.
decision.binding: Assess the woman's jacket in the edited image against the requested fully closed state, using the source image only as context. Inspect any visible portion of the front closure and the relationship between its edges. Do not infer closure or an opening from a panel hanging outward. Return pass or fail only when visible closure evidence supports that conclusion; otherwise return unknown.
